message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9×13‑inch pan) |
|----------|------------|-------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Regular or no‑boil lasagna sheets | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef or a mix of beef & pork | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper, dried oregano, basil, red‑pepper flakes | to taste |
| | Optional: red wine, bay leaf, carrot or celery (finely diced) | ¼ cup wine, 1 bay leaf, ½ cup carrot/celery |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 4 cups (1 L) |
| | Nutmeg, salt, pepper | pinch of nutmeg, to taste |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2 cups (200 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup (50 g) |

### Optional Extras
- **Vegetables**: Sautéed spinach, zucchini, mushrooms, or bell peppers can be layered in place of or alongside the meat.
- **Herbs**: Fresh basil, oregano, thyme, or rosemary for extra aroma.
- **Spices**: Smoked paprika, cayenne pepper, or a splash of balsamic vinegar for depth.

Feel free to adjust quantities based on your taste and the size of your baking dish. Enjoy your lasagna!
